name: Calvin A. Bernstein
tagline: Top rated Land Use & Zoning attorney in Highland Park, Illinois
education: The George Washington University Law School
about: Calvin A. Bernstein is the owner of the Highland Park-based law firm, Samuels & Bernstein, in Illinois. He brings a wealth of knowledge and a comprehensive background in real estate and governmental law to his practice, where he represents a diverse client base, including developers, landowners and homeowners. His work encompasses all facets of real estate finance, acquisition, development, zoning, and land use issues. Mr. Bernstein's advocacy extends to representing clients before various governmental bodies such as city councils, village boards and zoning boards of appeals, where he has consistently achieved favorable outcomes.

Mr. Bernstein's legal acumen also shines in the realm of real estate transactions, where he represents both buyers and sellers in commercial and residential settings. His responsibilities include negotiating and drafting critical documents such as real estate sales contracts, closing documents, and agreements related to section 1031 exchanges and environmental indemnities. His extensive involvement in the expansion of several retail chains highlights his deep understanding of leasing in the office, industrial and retail sectors.

Further broadening his practice, Mr. Bernstein is adept at forming business entities including C-corporations, S-corporations, joint ventures, partnerships and limited liability companies. He skillfully negotiates and prepares associated corporate documents such as minutes, operating agreements and shareholder agreements, ensuring legal compliance and protection for all parties involved.

In addition to his legal practice, Mr. Bernstein is deeply committed to his community. He has served as a commissioner on the Park District of Highland Park Board since 2007, where he chairs the board’s finance committee and various other advisory committees. His dedication also extends to his role as a charter member of the Highland Park Community Emergency Response Team and his former position on the Highland Park’s Zoning Board of Appeals.
Mr. Bernstein's academic credentials include a Bachelor of Arts degree with honors from the University of Wisconsin – Madison, and a Juris Doctor from The George Washington University School of Law.
